subject.title: fix(anthropic): keep OAuth callback on loopback

question: Should Anthropic OAuth reject every non-loopback `OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST` while keeping the provider-visible redirect URI fixed at `http://localhost:53692/callback`?
rationale: The patch narrows an existing auth-provider environment surface and relies on a provider redirect contract that source inspection and mocked tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept After Real Proof
options.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and an allowed loopback callback path, then accept the loopback-only bind host plus fixed localhost redirect contract.

options.title: Require Stronger Provider Contract Proof
options.body: Ask for live Anthropic or installed-client evidence that the fixed localhost redirect remains accepted for the supported loopback bind hosts before merge.

options.title: Pause For Auth Surface Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer removing or redesigning the direct Anthropic OAuth callback-host override instead of hardening it in place.

recommendation.title: Accept After Real Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and an allowed loopback callback path, then accept the loopback-only bind host plus fixed localhost redirect contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned on the live PR and authored the latest branch commits that define the current callback-host and redirect-URI behavior.
